faqs.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: You can manage your subscription through your App Store settings. Go to Settings → [Your Name] → Subscriptions → Victus, then select Cancel Subscription.

faqs.question: How does the 66-day challenge work?
faqs.answer: After onboarding, Victus generates a personalized plan based on your selected Pillars (Discipline, Fitness, Wellness, etc.). Each day, you'll receive a checklist of habits to complete. Completing habits earns you XP and builds your streak.

faqs.question: What are XP and Ranks?
faqs.answer: XP (Experience Points) are earned by completing daily habits. As you accumulate XP, you progress through ranks: Bronze → Silver → Gold → Spartan. Each rank represents your growth and mastery.

faqs.question: How does the leaderboard work?
faqs.answer: The Global Leaderboard shows all Victus users ranked by Total XP or Current Streak. It's a way to compete with warriors worldwide and stay motivated through friendly competition.

faqs.question: My streak broke. Can it be restored?
faqs.answer: Streaks are part of building true discipline and cannot be restored. However, every new day is a chance to start fresh and build an even stronger streak.

faqs.question: I found a bug. How do I report it?
faqs.answer: Please email support@getvictus.com with details about the issue, including your device model and iOS version. We appreciate your help in making Victus better!

faqs.question: Is Victus available on Android?
faqs.answer: Victus is currently iOS-only, but an Android version is in development. Email us to be notified when it launches.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: You can request account deletion from within the app's settings, or email support@getvictus.com. All your data will be permanently deleted from our servers.

privacyItems.title: 6. Information Collection
paragraphs: We collect information you voluntarily provide when you create an account and use the App. This includes:

bullets.label: Account Information:
bullets.text: Your email address and username.

bullets.label: Onboarding Information:
bullets.text: Your age range, self-assessed current state, chosen primary virtue, identified primary obstacle, and baseline habit data.

bullets.label: Usage Data:
bullets.text: Information about your interactions with the App, such as habits tracked, XP earned, and rank progression.

bullets.label: Device Data:
bullets.text: Your push notification token (if you consent) and your device advertising identifier (IDFA) if you provide consent through Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt.

privacyItems.title: 7. Use of Your Information
paragraphs: We use your information to:

bullets.text: Provide, operate, and improve our services.
Create and manage your account and process subscriptions.
Generate your personalized 66-day plan.
Display your progress and rank on your profile and the public leaderboard.
Send you push notifications.
Measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.

privacyItems.title: 8. Disclosure of Your Information
paragraphs: We share your information with trusted third-party service providers to perform services on our behalf, including:

bullets.label: Backend & Database:
bullets.text: Google Firebase

bullets.label: Subscription Management:
bullets.text: RevenueCat

bullets.label: Analytics:
bullets.text: Mixpanel, Firebase Crashlytics

bullets.label: Attribution & Advertising:
bullets.text: AppsFlyer, Meta (Facebook), Google, and TikTok

privacyItems.title: 8A. AI Services
paragraphs: Victus uses third-party AI services for its Face Score and Physique Score photo-analysis features.

When a user chooses to analyze a photo, Victus sends the selected image and limited information necessary to process the request and return the result to the user's account. This processing is performed through OpenRouter, Alibaba, and Gemini.
Victus does not send the user's name or email address as part of these photo-analysis requests.
Users can review this information in the app via Settings > Privacy, and on this Privacy Policy page.

privacyItems.title: 9. Data Security and Retention
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical measures to protect your data. Your data is retained for as long as your account is active or as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy.

privacyItems.title: 11. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: We do not knowingly collect information from or market to children under the age of 13.

privacyItems.title: 12. Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about these Terms or our Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@getvictus.com.
